description: Source file for ICM42688 sensor driver, including functions for device reset, configuration, FIFO management, and data reading.

methods.name: icm42688_reset
methods.description: Performs a soft reset and verifies device identity.

methods.name: icm42688_compute_fifo_wm
methods.description: Calculates FIFO watermark based on configuration.

methods.name: icm42688_configure
methods.description: Configures the sensor device with specified settings.

methods.name: icm42688_safely_configure
methods.description: Configures the device with fallback to previous configuration if failed.

methods.name: icm42688_read_all
methods.description: Reads all sensor data from the device.
